definitions.Low Stock: Positive usable stock is at or below the minimum stock level. Zero is Out of Stock.
definitions.Shortage Risk: Usable stock is zero, demand exhausts stock within the selected horizon, or days of supply are below lead time plus safety buffer.
definitions.Reorder Needed: There is no shortage risk, but demand plus minimum stock exceeds usable stock.
definitions.Sufficient: Stock covers demand, the replenishment window and the minimum ending-stock target.
